title: スプリングSの後に・止まらず先へ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the Spring Stakes behind her, Rice Shower carefully reviews her results and vows to work even harder.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the other hand, Mihono Bourbon's speed proved worthy of her nickname, the Auburn Rocket. The crowd's ecstatic cheers echo throughout the track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower can't stop working if she hopes to catch up to Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She sets her sights on the Japanese Derby and begins training in earnest.
